svg.text: COHERENT BIBLICAL ONTOLOGY

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Second Edition

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: This second edition of Coherent Biblical Ontology begins

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: where Scripture begins, with God creating a world that is

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: really there, and asks what that world is made of.

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Its answer is that created physical reality is relational

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: from its foundation. Possibility is shaped before anything

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: happens; what happens unfolds by constrained chance; things

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: persist by preserving what they are; and a difference here

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: becomes a consequence there through transmission, carriage

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: and reception. Mathematics describes this order with

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: extraordinary precision without being the order itself.

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Because the material world is relational at its base, the

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: relational life Scripture describes (promise, consequence,

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: responsibility, love) is not bolted onto an alien world.

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Yet material, living, personal and spiritual realities

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: remain distinct: relation across categories does not

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: erase category, and creation is not God.

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: The book is not an empirical proof of ultimate ontology.

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: It is an argument for the most globally coherent account

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: available, honest about evidence, uncertainty and

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: revelation, and governed throughout by Scripture.

text.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
